# RIXU Picks

> RIXU Picks (@rixupicks) is a hand-curated gallery of cheap, dark-aesthetic fashion finds from Meesho: tees, shirts, hoodies, jackets, jeans, cargo, kurtis, kurta sets, sarees, shoes and more, mostly under Rs 500.

- Every product is a Meesho listing. Buying happens on Meesho; this site only shows the pick and links to it with an affiliate link.
- Prices and ratings are shown as seen on Meesho when checked and may change; the live Meesho page is the source of truth.
- Language: Hinglish (Hindi + English). Creator: RIXU on Instagram, @rixupicks.
